tools.name: search_guidelines
tools.description: Searches the Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA and USDA mortgage guidelines and returns the most relevant verbatim passages. Each passage includes the document, version date, page, a ready-made citation (cite_as), the official source link and a citation URL on zeitro.com. A focused question per call (for example 'FHA student loan monthly payment calculation') returns the best passages. Passages may contain HTML tables. Lender overlays are not included.

question.description: A focused natural-language guideline question, e.g. 'maximum DTI for a manually underwritten FHA loan'.
question.title: Question

lenders.description: Restrict to these agencies: 'Fannie Mae', 'Freddie Mac', 'FHA', 'VA', 'USDA'. Lender names are accepted but their guidelines are not in the free tier.
lenders.title: Lenders

doc_ids.description: Restrict to these documents (doc_id values from earlier results).
doc_ids.title: Doc Ids

tools.name: get_document_pages
tools.description: Returns the full text of up to 5 consecutive pages of one agency guideline document (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA or USDA), with the document, version date, a ready-made citation and links. Useful when a passage is cut off or a table continues onto the next page.

doc_id.description: doc_id of an agency guideline document, from search results or the document list.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

end_page.description: Last page to read (inclusive). Defaults to start_page. At most 5 pages per call.
end_page.title: End Page

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Lists the guideline documents of one agency (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA or USDA): doc_id, title, version date and the agency's official source link.

tools.name: calculate_dti
tools.description: Calculates front-end (housing) and back-end (total) debt-to-income ratios from monthly income and monthly payments, and compares them with the published limits of Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA and USDA, automated and manual underwriting listed separately. Each limit carries its guideline citation (document, section, version, page, cite_as). With loan_amount, state and family_size it also returns VA's minimum residual income. Pure calculation: an estimate, not an underwriting decision.

monthly_income.description: Gross monthly qualifying income of all borrowers, in dollars.
monthly_income.title: Monthly Income

housing_payment.description: Proposed total monthly housing payment in dollars: principal and interest, property taxes, insurance, mortgage insurance and HOA dues.
housing_payment.title: Housing Payment

auto_loans.description: Monthly auto loan and lease payments. Default 0.
auto_loans.title: Auto Loans

student_loans.description: Monthly student loan payments as the agency counts them. Default 0.
student_loans.title: Student Loans

credit_cards.description: Minimum monthly payments on credit cards and other revolving accounts. Default 0.
credit_cards.title: Credit Cards

installment_loans.description: Other monthly installment loan payments. Default 0.
installment_loans.title: Installment Loans

alimony_child_support.description: Monthly alimony, child support and separate maintenance payments. Default 0.
alimony_child_support.title: Alimony Child Support

other_debts.description: Any other monthly debt payments, such as payments on other real estate. Default 0.
other_debts.title: Other Debts

loan_amount.description: Loan amount in dollars; selects VA's residual income table (below or from $80,000).
loan_amount.title: Loan Amount

state.description: Two-letter state code of the property, e.g. 'TX'; selects VA's residual income region.
state.title: State

family_size.description: Number of people in the household, for VA's residual income table.
family_size.title: Family Size

residual_income.description: The borrower's monthly residual income by VA's method, compared with VA's minimum.
residual_income.title: Residual Income

tools.name: calculate_fha_mip
tools.description: Calculates the FHA upfront and annual mortgage insurance premium (rates, dollar amounts, first-year monthly premium and how long the annual premium lasts) from the base loan amount, loan-to-value ratio, term and the case number date, using the HUD rate schedule in force for that date. Cites the Mortgagee Letter and HUD Handbook 4000.1 Appendix 1.0. Pure calculation: an estimate, not a loan approval.

base_loan_amount.description: Base loan amount in dollars, before any financed upfront premium.
base_loan_amount.title: Base Loan Amount

ltv.description: Loan-to-value ratio as a percent, e.g. 96.5: base loan amount divided by the lesser of price and appraised value.
ltv.title: Ltv

term_months.description: Loan term in months, e.g. 360 for 30 years or 180 for 15 years. Default 360.
term_months.title: Term Months

case_number_date.description: Date the FHA case number was assigned, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today (UTC).
case_number_date.title: Case Number Date

endorsement_date.description: Date FHA endorsed (or will endorse) the loan, YYYY-MM-DD, when known; it selects the 2023 rates for case numbers assigned before 2023-03-20.
endorsement_date.title: Endorsement Date

interest_rate.description: Note rate as an annual percent, e.g. 6.25; gives the first-year premium on the average scheduled balance.
interest_rate.title: Interest Rate

refinances_loan_endorsed_before_june_200.description: True for a Streamline or Simple Refinance of an FHA loan endorsed on or before May 31, 2009. Default false.
refinances_loan_endorsed_before_june_200.title: Refinances Loan Endorsed Before June 2009
